verses.gurmukhi: ਘੋਸਲਾ ਮੈ ਅੰਡਾ ਤਜਿ ਉਡਤ ਅਕਾਸਚਾਰੀ ਸੰਧਿਆ ਸਮੈ ਅੰਡਾ ਹੋਤ ਚੇਤਿ ਫਿਰ ਆਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ghosalaa mai a(n)ddaa taj uddat akaasachaaree sa(n)dhiaa samai a(n)ddaa hot chet fir aaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as a bird flies away in the open sky from the comfort of its nest, leaving its egg behind but returns due to its concern for the baby bird in the egg,

verses.gurmukhi: ਤਿਰੀਆ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਸੁਤ ਜਾਤ ਬਨਖੰਡ ਬਿਖੈ ਸੁਤ ਕੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਇ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: tireeaa tiaag sut jaat banakha(n)dd bikhai sut kee surat gireh aai sukh paaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as a labour woman leaves her child home under compulsion and goes to the jungle to pick up firewood, but keeps the memory of her child in the mind and finds comfort on returning home;

verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲ ਕੁੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਛਾਡੀਅਤਿ ਜਲਚਰੀ ਜਬ ਚਾਹੇ ਤਬ ਗਹਿ ਲੇਤ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise jal ku(n)dd kar chhaaddeeat jalacharee jab chaahe tab geh let man bhaaviee ||

en.bdb: Just as a pool of water is made and fish released in it to be caught again at one's will.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਚਿਤ ਚੰਚਲ ਭ੍ਰਮਤ ਹੈ ਚਤੁਰ ਕੰੁਟ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਬਿਹੰਗ ਠਹਿਰਾਵਈ ॥੧੮੪॥
verses.translit_en: taise chit cha(n)chal bhramat hai chatur ka(n)uT satigur bohith biha(n)g Thahiraaviee ||184||

en.bdb: So does the frolicsome mind of a human being wanders in all the four directions. But due to the ship-like Naam blessed by the True Guru, the wandering bird-like mind comes and rests in the self. (184)
